page_read.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM medical_clearance_watches w JOIN sportovci s ON s.id=w.sportovec_id WHERE 1=1
SELECT w.*,s.jmeno,s.prijmeni FROM medical_clearance_watches w JOIN sportovci s ON s.id=w.sportovec_id WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY w.next_review_on,w.id LIMIT 25 OFFSET 0

SELECT id,watch_id,state,issued_on,valid_until,replaces_id
        FROM medical_clearance_records WHERE watch_id IN (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?) ORDER BY id DESC

state_read.sql: SELECT w.id,r.id AS medical_record_id,r.state AS medical_record_state,r.issued_on AS medical_record_issued_on,r.valid_until AS medical_record_valid_until,r.replaces_id AS medical_record_replaces_id FROM medical_clearance_watches w JOIN sportovci s ON s.id=w.sportovec_id LEFT JOIN medical_clearance_records r ON r.watch_id=w.id WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY w.next_review_on,w.id,r.id DESC

SELECT w.*,s.jmeno,s.prijmeni FROM medical_clearance_watches w JOIN sportovci s ON s.id=w.sportovec_id
            WHERE w.id IN (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?) ORDER BY w.next_review_on,w.id
